- **ACT:EO:12938>EO:13094@1d4066c5ccfb9686**; S94dfc549a0719c7f210a402f; {"actor_id":"EO:13094","char_end":4728,"char_start":3947,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":2451,"char_start":1609,"text":"Except\nto the extent provided in section 203(b) of the International Emergency\nEconomic Powers Act (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)), where applicable, if the Secretary\nof State determines that a foreign person, on or after November 16, 1990,\nthe effective date of Executive Order 12735, the predecessor order to\nExecutive Order 12938, has materially contributed or attempted to contrib-\nute materially to the efforts of any foreign country, project, or entity\nof proliferation concern to use, acquire, design, develop, produce, or stock-\npile weapons of mass destruction or missiles capable of delivering such\nweapons, the measures set forth in subsections (b), (c), and (d) of this\nsection shall be imposed on that foreign person to the extent determined\nby the Secretary of State in consultation with the implementing agency\nand other relevant agencies."},{"char_end":4728,"char_start":3947,"text":"Departments and agencies of the United States Govern-\nment, acting in consultation with the Secretary of State, may, by license,\nregulation, order, directive, exception, or otherwise, provide for:\n(i) Procurement contracts necessary to meet U.S. operational military\nrequirements or requirements under defense production agreements; in-\ntelligence requirements; sole source suppliers, spare parts, components,\nroutine servicing and maintenance of products for the United States\nGovernment; and medical and humanitarian items; and\n(ii) Performance pursuant to contracts in force on the effective date\nof this order under appropriate circumstances.’’\n(b) Section 6 of Executive Order 12938 of November 14, 1994, is amended\nby deleting ‘‘4(c)’’ and inserting ‘‘4(e)’’ in lieu thereof."},{"char_end":5177,"char_start":4766,"text":"Nothing in this order is intended to\naffect the continued effectiveness of any rules, regulations, orders, licenses,\nor other forms of administrative action issued, taken, or continued in effect\nheretofore or hereafter under the authority of IEEPA, AECA, the Nuclear\nNon-Proliferation Act of 1978, the Nuclear Proliferation Prevention Act of\n1994, the Atomic Energy Act, the Export Administration Act (50 U.S.C."},{"char_end":5698,"char_start":5683,"text":"Effective Date."},{"char_end":5780,"char_start":5699,"text":"(a) This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on July\n29, 1998."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12938>EO:13094@1d4066c5ccfb9686","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Section 1.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":[],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"1998-07-28","target_id":"EO:12938","verb":"amend"}
  Text: [Tf0541835db21f36d41c6d2f1](#tf0541835db21f36d41c6d2f1); absolute characters 3947–4728
- **ACT:EO:12938>EO:13094@2a651d91a74f1939**; Sa3ef8a3f21dc8b2987a58475; {"actor_id":"EO:13094","char_end":5424,"char_start":3467,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":4643,"char_start":4305,"text":"Except as otherwise authorized, the importation into the United States, on or after the effective date, directly or indirectly, of any goods, technology, or services produced or provided by a designated foreign person, other than information or informational materials, is prohibited.\n§ 539.202 Prohibition on import-related transactions."},{"char_end":5036,"char_start":4644,"text":"Except as otherwise authorized, no United States person may finance, act as broker for, transfer, transport, or otherwise participate in the importation into the United States on or after the effective date of any goods, technology, or services produced or provided by a designated foreign person, other than information or informational materials.\n§ 539.203 Evasions; attempts; conspiracies."},{"char_end":5287,"char_start":5037,"text":"Any transaction by any United States person or within the United States on or after the effective date that evades or avoids, has the purpose of evading or avoiding, or attempts to violate any of the prohibitions set forth in this part is prohibited."},{"char_end":8731,"char_start":8272,"text":"The Department of State publishes in the Federal Register the names of persons determined to be subject to import measures pursuant to section 4(a) of E.O. 12938, as amended, and maintains a list of such persons accessible through the following page on the Department of State's website: https://www.state.gov/key-topics-bureau-of-international-security-and-nonproliferation/nonproliferation-sanctions/. \n[86 FR 73106, Dec. 27, 2021]\n§ 539.302 Effective date."},{"char_end":8996,"char_start":8732,"text":"The term effective date means the “effective date” specified in the relevant Federal Register notice issued by the Department of State identifying a designated foreign person. \n[64 FR 8716, Feb. 23, 1999, as amended at 86 FR 73106, Dec. 27, 2021]\n§ 539.303 Entity."}],"exceptions_text":["Except as otherwise authorized, the importation into the United States, on or after the effective date, directly or indirectly, of any goods, technology, or services produced or provided by a designated foreign person, other than information or informational materials, is prohibited","Except as otherwise authorized, no United States person may finance, act as broker for, transfer, transport, or otherwise participate in the importation into the United States on or after the effective date of any goods, technology, or services produced or provided by a designated foreign person, other than information or informational materials"],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12938>EO:13094@2a651d91a74f1939","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":[],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"1998-07-28","target_id":"EO:12938","verb":"transfer"}

- **ACT:EO:12938>EO:13094@fc12799f59cb9d86**; S5daaa4459af4683ca0c50fcb; {"actor_id":"EO:13094","char_end":42154,"char_start":36988,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":3696,"char_start":3156,"text":"Subpart C—General Definitions \n539.301 Designated foreign person. \n539.302 Effective date. \n539.303 Entity. \n539.304 Entity owned or controlled by a per-\nson listed in appendix I to this part. \n539.305 General license. \n539.306 Goods, technology, or services pro-\nduced or provided by a designated foreign \nperson. \n539.307 Importation into the United States. \n539.308 Information or informational mate-\nrials. \n539.309 License. \n539.310 Person. \n539.311 Specific license. \n539.312 United States. \n539.313 United States person; U.S. person."},{"char_end":7329,"char_start":6979,"text":"Except as otherwise authorized, the \nimportation into the United States, on \nor after the effective date, directly or \nindirectly, of any goods, technology, or \nservices produced or provided by a des-\nignated foreign person, other than in-\nformation or informational materials, \nis prohibited. \n§ 539.202 Prohibition on import-re-\nlated transactions."},{"char_end":7739,"char_start":7331,"text":"Except as otherwise authorized, no \nUnited States person may finance, act \nas broker for, transfer, transport, or \notherwise participate in the importa-\ntion into the United States on or after \nthe effective date of any goods, tech-\nnology, or services produced or pro-\nvided by a designated foreign person, \nother than information or informa-\ntional materials. \n§ 539.203 Evasions; attempts; conspir-\nacies."},{"char_end":7997,"char_start":7741,"text":"Any transaction by any United \nStates person or within the United \nStates on or after the effective date \nthat evades or avoids, has the purpose \nof evading or avoiding, or attempts to \nviolate any of the prohibitions set \nforth in this part is prohibited."},{"char_end":11803,"char_start":11331,"text":"The Department of \nState publishes in the FEDERAL REGISTER the \nnames of persons determined to be subject to \nimport measures pursuant to section 4(a) of \nE.O. 12938, as amended, and maintains a list \nof such persons accessible through the fol-\nlowing page on the Department of State’s \nwebsite: https://www.state.gov/key-topics-bu-\nreau-of-international-security-and-non-\nproliferation/nonproliferation-sanctions/. \n[86 FR 73106, Dec. 27, 2021] \n§ 539.302 Effective date."},{"char_end":12078,"char_start":11805,"text":"The term effective date means the \n‘‘effective date’’ specified in the rel-\nevant FEDERAL REGISTER notice issued \nby the Department of State identifying \na designated foreign person. \n[64 FR 8716, Feb. 23, 1999, as amended at 86 \nFR 73106, Dec. 27, 2021] \n§ 539.303 Entity."},{"char_end":36073,"char_start":35780,"text":"In the event no \nsettlement is reached, the 30–day pe-\nriod specified in paragraph (a) of this \nsection for written response to the \nprepenalty notice remains in effect un-\nless additional time is granted by the \nOffice of Foreign Assets Control. \n§ 539.704 Penalty imposition or with-\ndrawal."},{"char_end":41764,"char_start":40644,"text":"Subpart C—General Definitions \n542.300 Applicability of definitions. \n542.301 Blocked account; - **ACT:EO:12938>EO:13206**; S6c14ad479e9a720fdccb76a5; {"actor_id":"EO:13206","char_end":2812,"char_start":1439,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":1676,"char_start":1447,"text":"The revocation of Executive Order 12924 shall not affect any violation\nof any rules, regulations, orders, licenses, or other forms of administrative\naction under that order that occurred during the period the order was\nin effect."},{"char_end":2179,"char_start":1677,"text":"All rules and regulations issued or continued in effect under\nthe authority of IEEPA and Executive Order 12924, including those codified\nat 15 C.F.R. 730–74 (2000), and all orders, regulations, licenses, and other\nforms of administrative action issued, taken, or continued in effect pursuant\nthereto, remain in full force and effect, as if issued, taken, or continued\nin effect pursuant to and as authorized by the Act or by other appropriate\nauthority until amended or revoked by the proper authority."},{"char_end":3190,"char_start":2821,"text":"All rules, regulations, orders, licenses, and other forms of administra-\ntive action issued, taken, or continued in effect pursuant to the authority\nof IEEPA and Executive Order 12924 relating to the administration of section\n38(e) of the Arms Export Control Act (22 U.S.C. 2778(e)) shall remain in\nfull force and effect until amended or revoked under proper authority."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12938>EO:13206","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. - **ACT:EO:12938>EO:13382#5644-amend**; S774d1451880047044a39252d; {"actor_id":"EO:13382","char_end":5745,"char_start":5644,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":3630,"char_start":1463,"text":"(a) Except to the extent provided in section 203(b)(1), (3), and \n(4) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)(1), (3), and (4)), or in regulations, orders, \ndirectives, or licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwith-\nstanding any contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior \nto the effective date of this order, all property and interests in property \nof the following persons, that are in the United States, that hereafter come \nwithin the United States, or that are or hereafter come within the possession \nor control of United States persons, are blocked and may not be transferred, \npaid, exported, withdrawn, or otherwise dealt in: \n(i) the persons listed in the Annex to this order; \n(ii) any foreign person determined by the Secretary of State, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of the Treasury, the Attorney General, and other relevant \nagencies, to have engaged, or attempted to engage, in activities or trans-\nactions that have materially contributed to, or pose a risk of materially \ncontributing to, the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction or their \nmeans of delivery (including missiles capable of delivering such weapons), \nincluding any efforts to manufacture, acquire, possess, develop, transport, \ntransfer or use such items, by any person or foreign country of proliferation \nconcern; \n(iii) any person determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of State, the Attorney General, and other relevant \nagencies, to have provided, or attempted to provide, financial, material, \ntechnological or other support for, or goods or services in support of, \nany activity or transaction described in paragraph (a)(ii) of this section, \nor any person whose property and interests in property are blocked pursu-\nant to this order; and \n(iv) any person determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of State, the Attorney General, and other relevant \nagencies, to be owned or controlled by, or acting or purporting to act \nfor or on behalf of, directly or indirectly, any person whose property \nand interests in property are blocked pursuant to this order."},{"char_end":6918,"char_start":5845,"text":"Except \nto the extent provided in section 203(b) of the International Emergency \nEconomic Powers Act (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)), where applicable, if the Secretary \nof State, in consultation with the Secretary of the Treasury, determines \nthat a foreign person, on or after November 16, 1990, the effective date \nof Executive Order 12735, the predecessor order to Executive Order 12938, \nhas engaged, or attempted to engage, in activities or transactions that have \nmaterially contributed to, or pose a risk of materially contributing to, the \nproliferation of weapons of mass destruction or their means of delivery \n(including missiles capable of delivering such weapons), including any efforts \nto manufacture, acquire, possess, develop, transport, transfer, or use such \nitems, by any person or foreign country of proliferation concern, the measures \nset forth in subsections (b), (c), and (d) of this section shall be imposed \non that foreign person to the extent determined by the Secretary of State, \nin consultation with the implementing agency and other relevant agencies."},{"char_end":7734,"char_start":7484,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures to be effective in addressing \nthe national emergency declared in Executive Order 12938, as amended, \nthere need be no prior notice of a listing or determination made pursuant \nto section 1 of this order."},{"char_end":9479,"char_start":9397,"text":"(a) This order is effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on \nJune 29, 2005."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12938>EO:13382#5644-amend","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date. {"actor_id":"EO:13382","char_end":6918,"char_start":5845,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":3630,"char_start":1463,"text":"(a) Except to the extent provided in section 203(b)(1), (3), and \n(4) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)(1), (3), and (4)), or in regulations, orders, \ndirectives, or licenses that may be issued pursuant to this order, and notwith-\nstanding any contract entered into or any license or permit granted prior \nto the effective date of this order, all property and interests in property \nof the following persons, that are in the United States, that hereafter come \nwithin the United States, or that are or hereafter come within the possession \nor control of United States persons, are blocked and may not be transferred, \npaid, exported, withdrawn, or otherwise dealt in: \n(i) the persons listed in the Annex to this order; \n(ii) any foreign person determined by the Secretary of State, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of the Treasury, the Attorney General, and other relevant \nagencies, to have engaged, or attempted to engage, in activities or trans-\nactions that have materially contributed to, or pose a risk of materially \ncontributing to, the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction or their \nmeans of delivery (including missiles capable of delivering such weapons), \nincluding any efforts to manufacture, acquire, possess, develop, transport, \ntransfer or use such items, by any person or foreign country of proliferation \nconcern; \n(iii) any person determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of State, the Attorney General, and other relevant \nagencies, to have provided, or attempted to provide, financial, material, \ntechnological or other support for, or goods or services in support of, \nany activity or transaction described in paragraph (a)(ii) of this section, \nor any person whose property and interests in property are blocked pursu-\nant to this order; and \n(iv) any person determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation \nwith the Secretary of State, the Attorney General, and other relevant \nagencies, to be owned or controlled by, or acting or purporting to act \nfor or on behalf of, directly or indirectly, any person whose property \nand interests in property are blocked pursuant to this order."},{"char_end":6918,"char_start":5845,"text":"Except \nto the extent provided in section 203(b) of the International Emergency \nEconomic Powers Act (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)), where applicable, if the Secretary \nof State, in consultation with the Secretary of the Treasury, determines \nthat a foreign person, on or after November 16, 1990, the effective date \nof Executive Order 12735, the predecessor order to Executive Order 12938, \nhas engaged, or attempted to engage, in activities or transactions that have \nmaterially contributed to, or pose a risk of materially contributing to, the \nproliferation of weapons of mass destruction or their means of delivery \n(including missiles capable of delivering such weapons), including any efforts \nto manufacture, acquire, possess, develop, transport, transfer, or use such \nitems, by any person or foreign country of proliferation concern, the measures \nset forth in subsections (b), (c), and (d) of this section shall be imposed \non that foreign person to the extent determined by the Secretary of State, \nin consultation with the implementing agency and other relevant agencies."},{"char_end":7734,"char_start":7484,"text":"I therefore determine that for these measures to be effective in addressing \nthe national emergency declared in Executive Order 12938, as - **ACT:EO:12938>EO:13883**; S2e66e7b3f47fbb1816cd1fe9; {"actor_id":"EO:13883","char_end":14542,"char_start":11180,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":9070,"char_start":7436,"text":"(d)\n Waiver\n(1)\n Criteria for waiver\nThe President may waive the application of any sanction imposed with respect to a country pursuant to this section—\n(A)\n if—\n(i)\n in the case of any sanction other than a sanction specified in subsection (b)(2)(D) (relating to import restrictions) or (b)(2)(E) (relating to the downgrading or suspension of diplomatic relations), the President determines and certifies to the Congress that such waiver is essential to the national security interests of the United States, and if the President notifies the Committee on Foreign Relations of the Senate and the Committee on Foreign Affairs of the House of Representatives of his determination and certification at least 15 days before the waiver takes effect, in accordance with the procedures applicable to reprogramming notifications under section 634A of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 [22 U.S.C. 2394–1], or\n(ii)\n in the case of any sanction specified in subsection (b)(2)(D) (relating to import restrictions), the President determines and certifies to the Congress that such waiver is essential to the national security interest of the United States, and if the President notifies the Committee on Finance of the Senate and the Committee on Ways and Means of the House of Representatives of his determination and certification at least 15 days before the waiver takes effect; or\n(B)\n if the President determines and certifies to the Congress that there has been a fundamental change in the leadership and policies of the government of that country, and if the President notifies the Congress at least 20 days before the waiver takes effect."}],"exceptions_text":["except that such sanctions shall not apply to any contract or agreement entered into or license issued before the date of the presidential determination under section 5604(a)(1) of this title if the President determines that the application of such sanction would be detrimental to the national security interests of the United States"],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12938>EO:13883","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. - **ACT:EO:12938>EO:13883@2938fb333cdd6c03**; S2e66e7b3f47fbb1816cd1fe9; {"actor_id":"EO:13883","char_end":14542,"char_start":11180,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":9070,"char_start":7436,"text":"(d)\n Waiver\n(1)\n Criteria for waiver\nThe President may waive the application of any sanction imposed with respect to a country pursuant to this section—\n(A)\n if—\n(i)\n in the case of any sanction other than a sanction specified in subsection (b)(2)(D) (relating to import restrictions) or (b)(2)(E) (relating to the downgrading or suspension of diplomatic relations), the President determines and certifies to the Congress that such waiver is essential to the national security interests of the United States, and if the President notifies the Committee on Foreign Relations of the Senate and the Committee on Foreign Affairs of the House of Representatives of his determination and certification at least 15 days before the waiver takes effect, in accordance with the procedures applicable to reprogramming notifications under section 634A of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 [22 U.S.C. 2394–1], or\n(ii)\n in the case of any sanction specified in subsection (b)(2)(D) (relating to import restrictions), the President determines and certifies to the Congress that such waiver is essential to the national security interest of the United States, and if the President notifies the Committee on Finance of the Senate and the Committee on Ways and Means of the House of Representatives of his determination and certification at least 15 days before the waiver takes effect; or\n(B)\n if the President determines and certifies to the Congress that there has been a fundamental change in the leadership and policies of the government of that country, and if the President notifies the Congress at least 20 days before the waiver takes effect."}],"exceptions_text":["except that such sanctions shall not apply to any contract or agreement entered into or license issued before the date of the presidential determination under section 5604(a)(1) of this title if the President determines that the application of such sanction would be detrimental to the national security interests of the United States"],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:12938>EO:13883@2938fb333cdd6c03","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. chronology does not decide legal effect.","provision_text":"(2)\n Sanctions applied to existing contracts\nThe sanctions described in paragraphs (1), (2), and (3) of subsection (a) shall apply to contracts, agreements, and licenses without regard to the date the contract or agreement was entered into or the license was issued (as the case may be), except that such sanctions shall not apply to any contract or agreement entered into or license issued before the date of the presidential determination under section 5604(a)(1) of this title if the President determines that the application of such sanction would be detrimental to the national security interests of the United States.\n(Pub. L. 102–182, title III, § 307, Dec. 4, 1991, 105 Stat. 1254.)\nEditorial Notes\nReferences in Text\nThe Foreign Assistance Act of 1961, referred to in subsec. (a)(1), is Pub. L. 87–195, Sept. 4, 1961, 75 Stat. 424, which is classified principally to chapter 32 (§ 2151 et seq.) of this title. For complete classification of this Act to the Code, see Short Title note set out under section 2151 of this title and Tables.\nThe Arms Export Control Act, referred to in subsec. (a)(2)(A), (3), is Pub. L. 90–629, Oct. 22, 1968, 82 Stat. 1320, which is classified principally to chapter 39 (§ 2751 et seq.) of this title. For complete classification of this Act to the Code, see Short Title note set out under section 2751 of this title and Tables.\nSections 4604(c)(1) and 4605 of title 50, referred to in subsecs. (a)(5), (b)(2)(C), and (e)(1)(B), were repealed by Pub. L. 115–232, div. A, title XVII, § 1766(a), Aug. 13, 2018, 132 Stat. 2232.\nSection 304(b) of this title, referred to in subsec. (e)(1)(B), is section 304(b) of Pub. L. 102–182, title III, Dec. 4, 1991, 105 Stat. 1246, which amended former section 4605 of Title 50, War and National Defense.\nCodification\nIn subsec. (b)(2)(F)(iv), “section 40102(a) of title 49” substituted for “section 101 of the Federal Aviation Act of 1958 (49 U.S.C. App. 1301)” on authority of Pub. L. 103–272, § 6(b), July 5, 1994, 108 Stat. 1378, the first section of which enacted subtitles II, III, and V to X of Title 49, Transportation.\nExecutive Documents\nDelegation of Functions\nFunctions of President under this section delegated to Secretary of State, with certain exceptions, by section 1(b) of Ex. Ord. No. 12851, June 11, 1993, 58 F.R. 33181, set out as a note under section 2797 of this title.\nEx. Ord. No. 13883. longer."},{"char_end":25818,"char_start":23978,"text":"Doc. 40-4843; Filed, November 12, 1940; \n11:47 a. m.]\nV enezuela — Su spen sio n of T onnage  \nD uties\nBY THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES OF  \nAMERICA\nA PROCLAMATION\nWHEREAS section 4228 of the Revised \nStatutes of the United States, as \namended by the act of July 24,1897, c. 13, \n30 Stat. 214 (U.S.C., title 46, sec. 141), \nprovides, in part, as follows:\nUpon satisfactory proof being given to \nthe President, by the government of any \nforeign nation, that no discriminating duties \nof tonnage or imposts are imposed or levied \nin the ports of such nation upon vessels \nwholly belonging to citizens of the United \nStates, or upon the produce, manufac­\ntures, or merchandise imported in the \nsame from the United States or from any \nforeign country, the President may issue his \nproclamation, declaring that the foreign dis­\ncriminating duties of tonnage and impost \nwithin the United States are suspended and \ndiscontinued, so far as respects the vessels of \nsuch foreign nation, and the produce, manu­\nfactures, or merchandise imported into the \nUnited States from such foreign nation, or \nfrom any other foreign country; the suspen­\nsion to take effect from the time of such \nnotification being given to the President, and \nto continue so long as the reciprocal exemp­\ntion of vessels, belonging to citizens of the \nUnited States, and their cargoes, shall be \ncontinued, and no longer * * * ;\nAND WHEREAS satisfactory proof was \nreceived by me from -the Government \nof Venezuela on October 23, 1940, that \nno discriminating duties of tonnage or \nimposts are imposed or levied in the ports \nof Venezuela upon vessels wholly belong­\ning to citizens of the United States, or \nupon the produce, manufactures, or mer­\nchandise imported in such vessels, from \nthe United States, or from any foreign \ncountry:\nNOW, THEREFORE, I, Franklin D."},{"char_end":26536,"char_start":25820,"text":"Roosevelt, President of the United States \nof America, under and by virtue of the \nauthority vested in me by the above- \nquoted statutory provisions, do hereby \ndeclare and proclaim that the foreign \ndiscriminating duties of tonnage and im­\nposts within the United States are sus­\npended and discontinued so far as re­\nspects the vessels of Venezuela and the \nproduce, manufactures, or merchandise \nimported in said vessels into the United \nStates from Venezuela or from any other \nforeign country; the suspension to take \neffect from October 23, 1940, and to con­\ntinue so long as the reciprocal exemp­\ntion of vessels belonging to citizens of the\nUnited States and their cargoes shall be \ncontinued, and no longer."},{"char_end":34472,"char_start":32810,"text":"Except as provided in section 7 \nof this rule, a person holding a position \nwhen it is placed in the classified (com­\npetitive) service or otherwise is made \nsubject to competitive examination shall, j \nupon recommendation to the Commis­\nsion by the head of the department or \nagency in which he is employed have all \nthe rights which he would have acquired \nif appointed thereto by competitive ex­\namination: Provided:  (a) That he has \nrendered six months of satisfactory ac­\ntive service in the civilian executive \nbranch of the Federal Government im­\nmediately prior to the effective date of \nthe change in status of the position, and \ncontinues to serve in such position for 60 \ndays thereafter; (b) that he shall pass \nsuch appropriate noncompetitive tests of \nfitness as the Commission may prescribe; \nand (c) that he is not disqualified by any \nprovision of section 3 of Civil Service \nRule V or of any other civil service rule \nor by any provision of the Civil Service \nAct or any other statute or executive \norder: Provided further,  that in con­\nferring a classified competitive status \nupon any employee under this or any \nother rule or any statute or executive \norder, the Commission (a) may, in its \ndiscretion, exempt from the physical re­\nquirements established for any position \nany employee who has rendered long and \nfaithful service in a civil capacity for \nthe Government, and (b) may consider a \nperson whose name is carried on the \ncompensation rolls of the Employees’ \nCompensation Commission as having \nrendered satisfactory active service in \nthe position in which he last served for\nthe period which his name is carried on \nsuch rolls."},{"char_end":35568,"char_start":35193,"text":"On the effective date \nof any such order, section 6 of this rule \nshall apply to the positions, officers, and \nemployees of the offices affected, and all \nother provisions of these rules shall be­\ncome applicable to all officers and em­\nployees who so qualify and to all such \npositions thereafter filled in the same \nmanner as they apply to those in offices \nnow classified."},{"char_end":65237,"char_start":64857,"text":"All shipments \nallowable under these regulations shall \nbegin within six months of the effective \ndate of the transfer of the employee un- \nNo. 221-----2\nless an extension is specifically granted \nby the head of the department or estab­\nlishment: Provided,  That in no case \nshall payment be allowable for shipments \nbegun after two years from the effective \ndate of the transfer."},{"char_end":66941,"char_start":66926,"text":"Effective egister."},{"char_end":73856,"char_start":73398,"text":"(a) Whenever the Secretary [of \nAgriculture] finds that the total supply of \ntobacco as of the beginning of the marketing \nyear then current exceeds the reserve supply \nlevel therefor, the Secretary shall proclaim \nthe amount of such total supply, and, begin­\nning on the first day of the marketing year \nnext following and continuing throughout \nsuch year, a national marketing quota shall \nbe in effect for the tobacco marketed during \nsuch marketing year."},{"char_end":121818,"char_start":119225,"text":"It appearing,  That by order entered \nJuly 30, 1936, as amended by order en­\ntered October 31, 1938, the Commission \nentered into an investigation in and con­\ncerning the matter of establishing for \nprivate carriers of property engaged in \ninterstate or foreign commerce, if need \ntherefor is found, reasonable require­\nments to promote safety of operation \nand to that end prescribe qualifications \nand maximum hours of service of em­\nployees and standards of equipment;\nIt further appearing,  That a full in­\nvestigation of the matters and things \ninvolved was had and that the Commis­\nsion, Division 5, on May 1, 1940, made \nand filed a report containing its findings \nof fact and conclusions thereon and on \nthe same date entered an order pre­\nscribing regulations to promote the \nsafety of operation by private carriers of \nproperty engaged in interstate or foreign \ncommerce effective August 1, 1940;\nIt further appearing,  That the Com­\nmission, Division 5, by order of July 19, \n1940, postponed the effective date of said \nregulations to October 1, 1940, and by \norder of September 21, 1940, further \npostponed the effective date to October \n15, 1940;\nIt further appearing,  That the Com­\nmission, Division 5, by order entered \nSeptember 30, 1940,1  vacated and set \naside its order of May 1, 1940, and pre­\nscribed regulations to promote safety of \noperation by private carriers engaged in \ninterstate and foreign commerce which \ndiffered in some respects from the regu­\nlations prescribed by the said order of \nMay 1, 1940;\nIt further appearing,  That the Na­\ntional Retail Dry Goods Association filed \na petition requesting modification of cer­\ntain of the rules so prescribed, and that \non the date hereof the Commission, Di­\nvision 5, has made and filed a report \ngranting said petition in part, which re­\nport and said report of May 1, 1940, \ncontaining its findings of fact and con­\nclusions thereon, are hereby referred to \nand made a part hereof ;\nAnd it further appearing,  That said \npetition having been fully considered by \nthe Commission, and good cause there­\nfor appearing;\nIt is ordered, That effective December \n10,1940, said order of September 30,1940, \nbe, and it is hereby, amended so as to \nadd at the end of Rule 3 (a) of the hours \nof service regulations as it applies to \nprivate carriers of property the fol­\nlowing:\nProvided further, however,  That this \nrule shall not apply with respect to driv­\ners of motor vehicles engaged solely in \nmaking deliveries for retail stores during \nthe period from December 10 to Decem­\nber 25, both inclusive, of each year."},{"char_end":139161,"char_start":138762,"text":"If, during the continuance of the lease­\nhold term herein ## Valla review leads and component attestations

Review lead only. Every case needs separate applicability, earlier-ending, scope, independent-command, savings and independent whole-case review.
Preparation attestations never approve legal conclusions or replace whole-case review.

verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"The Secretary of State shall take all appropriate steps to complete, prior  \nto the date of entry into force of the Treaty Concerning the Permanent  \nNeutrality and Operation of the Panama Canal, hereinafter referred to as the  \nNeutrality Treaty, the negotiations which have begun with thè Republic of  \nPanama for an agreement under which the United States of America would,  \nupon the date of entry into force of such agreement and thereafter, administer  \nas a permanent American cemetery such part of Corozal Cemetery as encom­\npasses the remains of citizens of the United States of America."},{"char_end":2100,"char_start":1768,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":2100,"context_char_start":1768,"line":29,"pdf_page":15,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"Subject to the conclusion of the agreement referred to in Section 1-101  \nof this Order, the American Battle Monuments Commission shall administer  \nthat part of Corozal Cemetery which encompasses the remains of citizens of  \nthe United States of America, in accordance with the terms of the agreement  \nwith the Republic of Panama."},{"char_end":2424,"char_start":2108,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":2424,"context_char_start":2108,"line":34,"pdf_page":15,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"The Governor of the Canal Zone shall, to the extent funds are available,  \ndisinter from Mount Hope Cemetery, before entry into force of the Neutrality  \nTreaty, and reinter in Corozal Cemetery the remains of United States citizens,  \nand the remains of members of their immediate family that are buried with  \nthem."},{"char_end":2597,"char_start":2425,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":2597,"context_char_start":2425,"line":38,"pdf_page":15,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"The Governor shall not remove from Mount Hope Cemetery the remains  \nof any such person whose next of kin timely requests in writing that such  \nremains not be disinterred."},{"char_end":2816,"char_start":2598,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":2816,"context_char_start":2598,"line":40,"pdf_page":15,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"The Governor shall transport to the United States  \nfor reinterment the remains of any such person whose next of kin timely  \nrequests in writing that such remains be transported to the United States for  \nreinterment."},{"char_end":3219,"char_start":2824,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":3219,"context_char_start":2824,"line":44,"pdf_page":15,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"The Secretary of Defense shall, to the extent funds are available,  \ndisinter from Corozal Cemetery and transport to the United States for reinter­\nment the remains of United States citizens, and the remains of members of  \ntheir immediate family buried with them, whose next of kin requests in writing  \nby April 1, 1982, that such remains be transported to the United States for  \nreinterment."},{"char_end":3530,"char_start":3227,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":3530,"context_char_start":3227,"line":50,"pdf_page":15,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"Subject to the availability of funds, all the costs incurred in the  \ndisinterment, reinterment in Corozal Cemetery, and transportation of remains  \nrequired by this Order, including the costs of preparation, cremation if re­\nquested, and a casket or urn, shall be borne by die United States of America."},{"char_end":4287,"char_start":3972,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":4287,"context_char_start":3972,"line":62,"pdf_page":16,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"(a) The Governor of the Canal Zone shall identify, to the extent  \nfeasible, the closest surviving next of kin of each deceased United States  \ncitizen buried in the Mount Hope and Corozal Cemeteries, and of such next of  \nkin of each member of the immediate family that is buried with such United  \nStates citizen."}]},{"affected_orders":["EO:11203"],"availability":"citation_or_pointer_only","kind":"operative_current_law","reasons":["No uniquely located attributed legal-text slice is held for this current-law pointer; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"The transfer to the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission  \nof all the functions of the Equal Employment Opportunity Coordinating  \nCouncil, and the termination of that Council, as provided by Section 6 of  \nReorganization Plan Number 1  of 1978 (43 FR 19807), shall be effective on  \nJuly 1, 1978."},{"char_end":1663,"char_start":1319,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":1663,"context_char_start":1319,"line":23,"pdf_page":17,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"The Equal Employment Opportunity Commission shall provide  \nleadership and coordination to the efforts of Federal departments and agen­\ncies to enforce all Federal statutes, Executive orders, regulations, and policies  \nwhich require equal employment opportunity without regard to race, color,  \nreligion, sex, national origin, age or handicap."},{"char_end":1979,"char_start":1664,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":1979,"context_char_start":1664,"line":27,"pdf_page":17,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"It shall strive to maximize  \neffort, promote efficiency, and eliminate conflict, competition, duplication and  \ninconsistency among the operations, functions and jurisdictions of the Federal  \ndepartments and agencies having responsibility for enforcing such statutes,  \nExecutive orders, regulations and policies."},{"char_end":2224,"char_start":1987,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":2224,"context_char_start":1987,"line":32,"pdf_page":17,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"In carrying out its functions under this order the Equal Employ­\nment Opportunity Commission shall consult with and utilize the special exper­\ntise of Federal departments and agencies with equal employment opportunity  \nresponsibilities."},{"char_end":2384,"char_start":2225,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":2384,"context_char_start":2225,"line":35,"pdf_page":17,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"The Equal Employment Opportunity Commission shall coop­\nerate with such departments and agencies in the discharge of their equal  \nemployment responsibilities."},{"char_end":2644,"char_start":2392,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":2644,"context_char_start":2392,"line":38,"pdf_page":17,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall","shall"],"text":"All Federal departments and agencies shall cooperate with and  \nassist the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission in the performance of  \nits functions under this order and shall furnish the Commission such reports  \nand information as it may request."},{"char_end":2805,"char_start":2684,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":2805,"context_char_start":2684,"line":43,"pdf_page":17,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory;
